overview: In the Signature teaching of caregiving basics, The Future of Caregiving Basics is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Boundaries means define what you can and cannot do Ask for help means specific asks get yeses; vague ones get sympathy Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Advanced material that follows.
core_concepts: Boundaries: define what you can and cannot do
Ask for help: specific asks get yeses; vague ones get sympathy
key_laws: Write the plan down; memory fails under stress.
Ask for specific help; people want to help but need direction.
vocabulary: Respite: the planned caregiver break
Hospice: comfort care for end of life
methods: Sustain method: schedule weekly respite, keep your own medical care, join a support group
history: Family caregiving was always the norm; the late-1900s aging population made it a recognized role with formal supports and respite programs.
